Class
Description
AsyncRecordWriter

Represents a complete recorded HTTP interaction (request + response).

File rotation configuration.
RecordIOProperties.Masking
Masking configuration for sensitive data.
RecordMetadata
Metadata about the recorded request/response.
RecordWriter

RequestData
Represents the captured HTTP request data.

Represents the captured HTTP response data.
